$comment: Traceability: ADR-PROJ023-001 (Hybrid B+C), Phase 5 Purple Team Automation (Phase A Emulation, emulation_manifest checkpoint field), Phase 5 Red-Blue Composition (RM-1 Emulation manifest output, RM-2 Technique-tagged artifacts). AC-F-11: validates per EM-01..EM-08 rules. REQ-HND-007: emulation manifest schema definition. Storage: work/purple-team/exchange/{engagement-id}/manifest.yaml
title: Emulation Manifest v1
description: Schema for purple team emulation plans and Phase A output manifests. Records which ATT&CK techniques were emulated, by which red-team agents, with what artifacts and indicators, and at what emulation status. Used by Sessions 2+ to discover Phase A artifacts without re-reading red-team output. Validates per EM-01 through EM-08 rules: EM-01 techniques array required; EM-02 each technique must have a technique_id; EM-03 technique_id must match ATT&CK format; EM-04 each artifact_path must resolve within work/ and not contain '..'; EM-05 emulation_status must be a valid enum; EM-06 producing_agent must be a valid red-team agent name; EM-07 agent_contributions is derivable from techniques array; EM-08 artifact_count must equal the sum of all artifact_paths arrays.

manifest_id.description: Unique manifest identifier. Format: manifest-{engagement-id}-s{session-number}. One manifest per emulation session.

engagement_id.description: Identifier of the purple team engagement. Matches the engagement_id in RBEE, CFE, and DGE envelopes.

session_id.description: Session identifier from which this manifest was produced. Format: purple-{engagement-id}-s{N}.

purple_iteration.description: Purple team loop iteration this manifest covers. 1 for the first emulation session, 2+ for re-emulation in subsequent iterations. Null for standalone (non-looping) emulation plans.

techniques.description: EM-01: techniques array is required (may be empty for pre-exercise manifests with no emulated techniques yet). Each entry covers one ATT&CK technique emulated in this session. EM-02: each technique entry must include technique_id.

items.description: Per-technique emulation record. EM-02: technique_id required. EM-03: technique_id must match ATT&CK format. EM-05: emulation_status must be a valid enum. EM-06: assigned_agent must be a valid red-team agent name.

technique_id.description: EM-03: ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID. Must match ^T\d{4}(\.\d{3})?$. Validated at manifest creation and at session resumption.

assigned_agent.description: EM-06: Red-team agent responsible for emulating this technique. Must be a valid /red-team agent name in kebab-case with 'red-' prefix.

zone.description: Security zone in which this emulation executes. Purple team emulation is Zone 1 (Analysis) only -- red-reporter is read-only when producing purple team output.

emulation_status.description: EM-05: Emulation status enum. PLANNED: technique selected but not yet attempted. IN_PROGRESS: emulation is under way (single-session only). COMPLETE: emulation produced artifacts. EMULATION_SKIPPED: technique in scope but not emulated (e.g., requires infrastructure outside scope). EMULATION_FAILED: emulation attempted but failed. NOT_IN_SCOPE: technique identified but not selected for this exercise.

skip_reason.description: Required when emulation_status is EMULATION_SKIPPED or EMULATION_FAILED. Explains why emulation could not proceed.
examples: EMULATION_SKIPPED: Phishing requires social engineering infrastructure outside scope

items.description: EM-04: Path to an emulation artifact. Must resolve within work/ subtree. Must NOT contain '..' path traversal sequences.

artifact_paths.description: EM-04: Filesystem paths to artifacts produced by emulating this technique. All paths validated at manifest creation and before Session 2+ access (RV-02). May be empty when emulation_status is PLANNED or EMULATION_SKIPPED.

items.description: Path to a structured indicator extraction file. Must resolve within work/ subtree. Must NOT contain '..'.

indicator_paths.description: Paths to structured indicator files extracted from this technique's emulation artifacts. Used by blue-ioc for detection rule creation.

artifact_type.description: Expected artifact type for this technique.

required_for_detection.description: Whether this artifact is required for blue-detect to validate detection coverage. When true and artifact is missing, detection is marked UNVALIDATED.

expected_artifacts.description: Expected artifacts for this technique. Used in emulation plan phase to document what should be produced before emulation begins.

indicators_extracted.description: Summary of indicators extracted from emulation artifacts. Populated after COMPLETE status.

rbee_envelope_path.description: Path to the RBEE envelope created from this technique's finding. Set after RBEE creation in the IP-5 pipeline.

metadata_tags.description: Optional tags for technique categorization (e.g., persistence, low-noise, requires-admin).

phases.description: Multi-phase emulation sequencing. Each phase groups techniques by emulation order and agent assignment. Enables phased emulation plans (e.g., recon before exploitation before persistence).

phase_id.description: Phase identifier. Format: phase-{N} where N is the sequential phase number.

items.description: ATT&CK technique ID. Must correspond to an entry in the techniques array.

technique_ids.description: Technique IDs to be emulated in this phase. Each ID must exist in the root techniques array.

entry_criteria.description: Conditions that must be met before this phase begins.

exit_criteria.description: Conditions that mark this phase as complete.

depends_on_phases.description: Phase IDs that must be completed before this phase can begin.

success_criteria.description: Exercise-level success criteria. Defines when the emulation phase is considered complete. At minimum one criterion required.
examples: At least one technique emulated per ATT&CK tactic in scope
All emulation artifacts persisted with SHA-256 hashes
Emulation evidence manifest produced with technique IDs and artifact paths

termination_conditions.description: Conditions that terminate the emulation phase regardless of completion status. At minimum one condition required.
examples: Zero techniques successfully emulated after all in-scope techniques attempted
Context budget limit reached (Session 1 tokens exceed 165K threshold)

agent_contributions.description: EM-07: Agent-to-technique mapping, derivable from the techniques array (assigned_agent field). Provided here for quick lookup without iterating the full techniques array. MUST be consistent with the techniques array: each key maps to a red-team agent name, each value is the array of technique_ids that agent emulated.

additionalProperties.description: Technique IDs emulated by this agent.

artifact_count.description: EM-08: Total artifact count across all techniques. MUST equal the sum of all artifact_paths array lengths in the techniques entries. Used for manifest integrity verification at session resumption.

tactics_in_scope.description: ATT&CK tactics selected for emulation in this exercise.

total_techniques_in_scope.description: Total number of techniques selected for emulation.

techniques_attempted.description: Number of techniques for which emulation was attempted (COMPLETE + EMULATION_FAILED).

techniques_complete.description: Number of techniques with emulation_status = COMPLETE.

techniques_skipped.description: Number of techniques with emulation_status = EMULATION_SKIPPED.

trust_classification.description: Trust boundary classification for manifest artifacts. Emulation manifests reference adversary-tainted artifacts.

artifact_taint_level.description: Default taint level for artifacts referenced in this manifest. Individual artifacts may override via their own taint_level field in RBEE envelopes.

zone.description: Security zone for emulation manifest production. red-reporter is read-only when producing purple team output -- Zone 1 only.

manifest_metadata.description: Administrative metadata for manifest tracking and session resumption.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the manifest was created.

last_updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent update to the manifest.

schema_version.description: Emulation manifest schema version for forward compatibility.

prior_exercise_manifest.description: Path to the manifest from the prior purple team exercise, if this is a follow-on exercise. Used by red-lead when DGE coverage gaps informed this exercise scope.

attack_technique_id.description: ATT&CK technique or sub-technique ID. Format: T{NNNN} or T{NNNN}.{NNN}.
